spec.arc: Your first morning at Nilebridge: Hana prints your staff badge while Daniel, visiting from Toronto, arrives at the same time.

canDo.en: I can greet people and introduce myself (name, job, city).
canDo.ar: أقدر أسلّم على الناس وأعرّف نفسي (الاسم والوظيفة والمدينة).

canDo.en: I can ask someone's name, job and city.
canDo.ar: أقدر أسأل حد عن اسمه ووظيفته ومدينته.

canDo.en: I can reply to "Nice to meet you."
canDo.ar: أقدر أرد على «Nice to meet you».

surprises: Daniel mishears your name → say it again (preview of Day 2).

teaser.en: Tomorrow: your badge has a spelling mistake. Can you fix it?
teaser.ar: بكرة: اسمك على الكارت مكتوب غلط — تعرف تصلّحه؟

lines.speaker: daniel
lines.text: Thanks! Nice to meet you too.

lines.speaker: hana
lines.text: The Support team is on the fourth floor.
